title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
title_zh: ViDecide：让视频扩散模型逐步推理与规划
abstract_en: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.
abstract_zh: 当前领先的视频生成模型虽然能合成逼真的视频，但即使经过大规模推理数据训练或使用现有的扩散模型强化学习方法，在多步推理与规划中仍常违反物理和逻辑约束。作者认为，问题在于传统训练把解题过程视为固定长度的视频片段，而不是一连串决策。为此，ViDecide 采用以决策为中心的训练调度，让视频扩散模型根据已有状态逐步预测下一步状态，并自主判断何时停止。论文还提出纠错微调（Corrective Fine-tuning，CFT），将导致失败决策的噪声映射到模型自身生成的成功后续轨迹，无需策略梯度优化即可稳定提升表现。在抽象游戏、规划任务和新提出的多步机器人规划基准上，ViDecide 的平均严格成功率达到 83.8%，高于标准微调的 23.3% 和最强既有方法的 67.8%，并能泛化到更大规模的谜题和未见过的布局。
key_points_zh: ViDecide 将训练目标从生成固定长度的视频改为逐步预测状态转移，并让模型自主决定何时停止。
Corrective Fine-tuning（CFT）用模型自身生成的成功后续轨迹纠正失败决策，无需策略梯度优化。
在抽象游戏、规划任务和多步机器人规划基准上，平均严格成功率为 83.8%，比最强既有方法高 16.0 个百分点。
模型能够泛化到更大规模的谜题和训练中未见过的布局。
